verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms HelixDB serves an llms.txt at docs.helix-db.com that describes the product. Separately, `helix chef` installs HelixDB query skills and a docs MCP for agents, and the docs are published as raw .md pages agents can consume. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents use these docs effectively, and details on llms.txt depth (e.g., a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.helix-db.com/llms.txt # HelixDB
It installs the HelixDB query skills and docs MCP
`helix chef` can automate local scaffolding and agent setup without any Cloud login.
